title: eyetools: Analyse Eye Data — eyetools-package
text: Enables automation actions across pipeline, including initial steps transforming binocular data gap repair event-based processing fixations, saccades, entry/duration Areas Interest (AOIs). also offers visualisation eye movement AOI entries. tools take relatively raw (trial, time, x, y form) data can used return fixations, saccades, AOI entries time spent AOIs. tools rely basic data format, functions can work data eye tracking device. title: Fixation detection using a velocity threshold identification method — fixation_VTI
text: Determine fixations assessing velocity eye-movements, using method similar proposed Salvucci & Goldberg (2000). Applies algorithm used VTI_saccade removes identified saccades assessing whether separated fixations outside dispersion tolerance. outside tolerance, fixation treated new fixation regardless length saccade separating . Compared fixation_dispersion(), fixation_VTI() conservative determining fixation smaller saccades discounted resulting data treated continued fixation (assuming within pixel tolerance set disp_tol).
